title: Products of image components have additive degree
statement: theorem graded_image_mul (R : Type u) (M : Type v) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] : ∀ n m : ℕ, (((TensorAlgebra.ι R : M →ₗ[R] TensorAlgebra R M).range ^ n).map (algHom R M).toLinearMap) * (((TensorAlgebra.ι R : M →ₗ[R] TensorAlgebra R M).range ^ m).map (algHom R M).toLinearMap) ≤ ((TensorAlgebra.ι R : M →ₗ[R] TensorAlgebra R M).range ^ (n + m)).map (algHom R M).toLinearMap

source.place: Algebra, Section 00DM (section-tensor-algebra, line 2165): T(M) is the direct sum of the T^n(M) with T^n * T^m in T^{n+m}; Sym(M) is the quotient of T(M) by the two-sided ideal generated by the degree-2 elements x (x) y - y (x) x, and Sym^n(M) is the image of T^n(M) (the text writes 'the image of a pure tensor x_1 (x) ... (x) x_n in Sym^n(M)'); the grading of the quotient by an ideal generated by homogeneous elements is used there without statement

proof.text: Introduce n and m. Rewrite the product of mapped submodules using Submodule.map_mul backwards, then rewrite the product of powers using pow_add backwards; the resulting inclusion is reflexive.

proof_origin.place: Lean proof using Submodule.map_mul and pow_add in Sheaf.LinearAlgebra.SymmetricAlgebra.Graded
